description: South Korea 20% a year statutory interest on unpaid wages (Labor Standards Act art. 37): for wages and lump-sum severance owed at resignation or death, from the day after the 14-day deadline; for regular wages of current employees, from the day after the payday (paydays from 2025-10-23). Not for interim severance settlements (6%/12% per a 2026 Supreme Court ruling); excused delay periods are not modeled.

dueEventDate.description: final_settlement: separation (or death) date; regular_payday: the missed payday (YYYY-MM-DD)

paidDate.description: Payment date, last day counted; default today (YYYY-MM-DD)

wageType.description: final_settlement (owed at resignation or death, default) or regular_payday (regular wages while employed)

name: unpaid_wage_interest
title: Unpaid wage interest (South Korea)
